Frequently asked

Where do my conversations live? ＋

On this machine, in this app's own local storage — see Settings → Privacy.

What does "Allow edits" actually let it do? ＋

It can read files and draft, edit and organise on its own. Anything that sends, buys, deletes or leaves your machine still asks first. See Settings → What it may do.

Can I run helloim.ai fully offline? ＋

With a local brain connected under Settings → AI Brain, yes. Turn on Air-gap under Settings → Internet connection and every brain — including the AI Boardroom — is restricted to offline models only.

How does the AI Boardroom decide? ＋

Every connected brain answers on its own, then your Primary brain reads all the answers and writes one recommendation — agreements and splits both stay visible.

    Where we left off

      On this PC

      This brain won't add memories from chat by itself yet — automatic capture isn't wired up for it here. You can always add one yourself, right below. Reading, editing and forgetting still work exactly the same.

      In your own words

      Eleven questions about what you think, what happened to you, and how you actually talk — plus anywhere you would rather just paste something. Answer any of them, in any order, whenever you feel like it. None of them is required, and what you write is kept exactly the way you wrote it.

      Anything you have already written

      An email, a post, a message — it does not need to be good, and it does not need to be about work. This is the fastest thing on this page and it asks nothing of you.

      Hear the difference

      Answer one question above, or paste something you have written, and this will write the same short piece twice — once without your answers and once with them — so you can hear what changed.

      This sends two real requests to whichever brain you have chosen, and reads nothing on your computer.

      connect the services you already use Esc

      Connect Google

      Sign in on Google’s website and approve Gmail reading, editing and sending, and Calendar event viewing and editing. Existing connections need Edit and renewed approval to enable sending and calendar changes. Most actions you request in chat run within the access you granted. Sending or replying to an email always asks you to confirm each message first — and it is available once you connect your own AI brain; the built-in assistant can read, organize and draft, but does not send. Google sign-in currently supports approved beta test accounts. Authorization tokens pass through helloim.ai’s secure exchange service; mail and calendar content travels directly between this app and Google.

      Connect Microsoft

      Sign in on Microsoft’s website and approve reading, editing and sending Outlook mail, and viewing and editing your calendar. Most actions you request in chat run within the access you granted. Sending or replying to an email always asks you to confirm each message first — and it is available once you connect your own AI brain; the built-in assistant can read, organize and draft, but does not send. Microsoft sign-in uses a public app with no shared secret; mail and calendar content travels directly between this app and Microsoft.

      Connect your email

      Stored in your operating system credential store. This connection can list and read inbox messages; it cannot send, delete, or mark them read. Outlook and Microsoft 365 sign-in is not available yet.

      Each app you connect is a live link out to that service. A connected app can receive the things you ask Giles to do with it — you'll see exactly what before you connect each one. Apps marked On this PC stay on your machine.
